what: The coverage-lift uplift domain: a provider-proposed test gated on the MEASURED function coverage of a named target module, parsed directly from NODE_V8_COVERAGE (dependency-free -- no c8), not on structure. Baseline of an un-exercised module is ~0%, so reaching the floor is the lift.

cases.thorough: verdict=pass, funcsPct=100 (all 4 functions + the module called)
cases.weak: verdict=fail, funcsPct=40 (< 80 floor; module + classify of 5 functions; the test still ran, exit 0)

liveOllama.inspected: benign -- imports ./target.mjs, calls classify/clamp/sum/fib, process.exit(0); no fs, no network, no child_process

safety: Measuring executes the proposed test. The deterministic gate runs only TRUSTED hand-authored tests. UNTRUSTED provider-proposed tests should be measured inside the DISPOSABLE cleanroom VM (the harness runs identically there), not on a trusted host. Node --permission cannot be combined with V8 coverage, so isolation is by disposable environment, not by in-process sandbox. The live test above was inspected before execution.
note: Coverage is measured as FUNCTION coverage parsed directly from NODE_V8_COVERAGE (dependency-free, no c8), so the gate runs under the pure dependency-free local suite (experiments/verify-local-gates.mjs) too. Gate additionally on branch coverage for stricter uplift.
